title: VendPoint Credit Hold Vending Settings
content:
Credit department settings of the VendPoint Industrial Vending Program: what each machine model still vends while the customer's credit account is on hold.

- **Credit hold vending rule**: what the machine still vends while the customer's credit account is on hold. The rule takes one of two values: **lock machine** (nothing vends) or **safety items only**.
- **Credit hold safety categories**: product categories that keep vending under the safety items only rule.

| | VendPoint Locker 12 | VendPoint Locker 24 | VendPoint Coil 40 | VendPoint Coil 60 | VendPoint Carousel 90 | VendPoint Smart Crib 300 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Credit hold vending rule | lock machine | lock machine | lock machine | safety items only | safety items only | safety items only |
| Credit hold safety categories | safety and PPE | safety and PPE | safety and PPE | safety and PPE | safety and PPE | safety and PPE |

### Points of reading

- The safety categories are listed for every model, but they matter only on a model whose rule is safety items only: the VendPoint Coil 60, Carousel 90 and Smart Crib 300.
- On the VendPoint Locker 12, Locker 24 and Coil 40 the rule is lock machine.
- The one category on the list is safety and PPE.
